$comment: Role registry. The authored source of truth for the ESPD role model: the buyer types that create a Request and the economic-operator roles that create a Response, each with its form behaviour (which Parts are visible/editable, and the mandatory/optional disposition of the four exclusion-ground categories). EO roles additionally carry an `xmlMapping` (cac:EconomicOperatorParty/cac:EconomicOperatorRole/cbc:RoleCode = <EoRoleType code>), which the Part II §A mapping serialises. The BUYER types carry NO xmlMapping: in ESPD-EDM 5.0.0 the buyer/EO split is STRUCTURAL (a Request's cac:ContractingParty vs a Response's cac:EconomicOperatorParty), and there is no grounded serialization for the Contracting-Authority vs Contracting-Entity sub-distinction — cbc:PartyTypeCode has no ESPD codelist and no Schematron rule, so the former cont-auth/cont-ent mapping (an ungrounded carry-over) was removed. The two buyer types are kept so the CA/CE regulatory distinction (Directive 2014/24 vs 2014/25) survives in the model for when further buyer roles are introduced, even though the UI now presents a single 'Buyer'. Ported from the legacy espd-edm/roles.json and extended with exclusionCategoryMap (the Part III section-code -> exclusion-category prefix map that js/model.js currently hard-codes). The compiler (model/compiler/roles.mjs) validates this and emits model/generated/ui/roles.json; English label/description text is split out to the i18n catalogue, keyed role.label.<id> / role.description.<id>, mirroring the codelist service-data lens.

exclusionCategoryMap.$comment: Maps a Part III exclusion-ground section-code PREFIX to its exclusion category. Longest-match-independent: prefixes are mutually exclusive. 'exg-sitn' (conflicts of interest / distortion situations) rolls up to 'misconduct', matching the legacy EXCLUSION_CATEGORY_MAP in js/model.js.

buyerTypes.label: Contracting Authority
buyerTypes.description: A contracting authority subject to Directive 2014/24/EU creating an ESPD Request.

formBehavior.$comment.partV: Part V (reduction of the number of qualified candidates) is intentionally NOT shown to buyers: it has no buyer requirement to express and nothing to edit; the economic operator answers it. So it is omitted from visible/editableParts here.

buyerTypes.label: Contracting Entity
buyerTypes.description: A contracting entity subject to Directive 2014/25/EU (utilities: water, energy, transport, postal services) creating an ESPD Request.

formBehavior.$comment.partV: Part V (reduction of the number of qualified candidates) is intentionally NOT shown to buyers: it has no buyer requirement to express and nothing to edit; the economic operator answers it. So it is omitted from visible/editableParts here.

eoRoles.label: Sole tenderer
eoRoles.description: Economic operator which has submitted a tender without being part of a group of economic operators.

eoRoles.label: Group leader
eoRoles.description: Economic operator which is the leader of a group of economic operators.

eoRoles.label: Group member
eoRoles.description: Economic operator, which is a member of a group of economic operators, without being the leader.

eoRoles.label: Other entity (relied upon)
eoRoles.description: Economic operator (who is not a subcontractor) on which the tenderer relies upon, to meet selection criteria.

eoRoles.label: Subcontractor
eoRoles.description: Economic operator to whom the contractor assigns a share of the contract.
